title: Where side effects go: event handlers

slides.say: Updating the screen, starting an animation, changing data. These are side effects. So where do they go?
They usually belong in event handlers. Handlers are defined inside your component, but they do not run during rendering. So they do not need to be pure.

slides.text: No fitting handler? useEffect runs it after render. But that is your last resort.
slides.say: No fitting event handler? You can use use effect, which runs after rendering. But the docs call that a last resort.

slides.text: First try to express your logic with rendering alone.
slides.say: Takeaway: try rendering alone first, then event handlers, and only then an effect.
